lead_headline: Odde's Lounge closes in Westminster after 5-year run — subscriber churn ticks up with net -1 yesterday

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead today: Odde's Lounge (Regis/Westminster) shuttered permanently after 5-year speakeasy run alongside its Mojo-99 Burgers sibling, marking the end of the family's dual-concept operation.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications for the fourteenth consecutive day as Colorado's licensing blackout stretches through mid-May with no restoration target. The 7-day window remains frozen at absolute zero versus last Thursday's identical void, now marking two full weeks since the April 29-30 renewal deluge deposited 2,144 applications and crashed the queue. No new filings, no status updates, no backend movement — the system paralysis persists across all license types with May's calendar completely dark through the 14th. State officials remain silent on timeline or root cause as the two-week mark passes without triage visibility.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention yesterday — a Romyo Denver R&D pop-up sellout on Instagram — collapses the 7-day total to 52 across 9 sources, up 30% from last week's 40 but down sharply from Wednesday's 48-mention peak. Denver Post still dominates with 20 mentions (38% share), followed by Instagram (11) and scattered social cross-posts. The single-mention Thursday marks the week's slowest day after Sunday-Tuesday averaged 8 mentions daily, suggesting midweek fatigue before the Friday news cycle. Google News RSS continues driving 96% of discoveries (50 of 52) as the week's momentum concentrates in early-week real estate and development stories.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −1 yesterday (0 new, 1 canceled) nudges MTD to +17 (+1.3/day) while 90-day net holds at +139. Tuesday's single cancellation with zero acquisition marks the second net-negative day this week after Sunday's −2, compressing the 7-day tally to +1 (17 new, 16 canceled) — down 95% from last week's +20 (24 new, 4 canceled). Acquisition collapsed 29% week-over-week while cancellations quadrupled, flipping the model from strong inbound flow to elevated churn pressure. MTD's +1.3/day rate still matches YTD baseline but masks recent volatility — the last three days averaged −1 net versus the prior four-day stretch that delivered +2/day. Retention strain builds through mid-month even as longer-term fundamentals remain steady.
